name: CombatMeter
description: Real-time party DPS/HPS meter with role colours.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Live party DPS/HPS with role colours.
History — damage timeline with navigator and per-source table.

added: The meter now records the buffs on you and your teammates, your stat changes, your party's skill casts and your own cooldown speed during a fight. The logs site uses them for its new experimental view — Own and Given DPS, an FFLogs-style rDPS line, and a Buffs and Debuffs tab — so you can see how much of a run's damage came from cooldown and damage buffs, and who gave them.
Buffs cast by a Battle Imagine such as Tina are credited to the player who summoned it.

The logs site marks Own DPS, Given DPS, rDPS and the Buffs and Debuffs tab as experimental while they settle in, so the numbers can still change; your parse and your rankings are unaffected and keep using raw DPS.
changed: Nothing changes in the meter window itself; the new data rides along with your normal uploads.
fixed: A very short archive right after a boundary could produce a negative duration and fail to upload (red "Failed" badge). It now uploads as a 0-second segment.
A leftover testing-server setting from the testing channel could make a stable build upload to the testing site; stable builds now always upload to the production logs site.
